# PantoneConverter.com

> A free, browser-based set of tools for matching Pantone spot colours to and from HEX, RGB, CMYK, LAB and the industrial, paint, craft and textile colour systems used in real production work.

Every conversion runs client-side in the visitor's browser against bundled colour datasets — nothing is uploaded and no account is required. Matches are ranked by CIEDE2000 (ΔE*00) colour difference, and the site states the honest match quality rather than implying an exact equivalent exists. This is an independent reference site, not a Pantone LLC product.

This file lists every indexable page on the site. A shorter curated index is at https://pantoneconverter.com/llms.txt

## Home & Core Tools

- [Pantone Color Converter](https://pantoneconverter.com/): Entry point to every converter — convert CMYK, HEX, RGB or HSL to the nearest Pantone PMS colour, or look up a Pantone code's values.
- [Pantone Color Finder](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-finder/): Searchable browser for the whole PMS library with filters for coated, uncoated, metallic and pastel; each swatch expands to HEX, RGB and CMYK.
- [Image to Pantone Extractor](https://pantoneconverter.com/image-to-pantone/): Upload an image and pull its dominant colours out as Pantone matches; the file is read in the browser and never leaves the device.
- [Pantone Color Comparison Tool](https://pantoneconverter.com/compare/): Puts two Pantone colours side by side with their HEX, RGB and CMYK values and the measured difference between them.
- [TCX vs TPX vs TPG Explained](https://pantoneconverter.com/tcx-vs-tpx-vs-tpg/): Explains the three Pantone textile suffixes — cotton versus paper stock, which are current, why TPX was retired — with a TCX lookup built in.

## Converters

### To Pantone from a digital colour model

- [HEX to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/hex-to-pantone/): Takes a HEX code and returns the closest PMS colours, ranked by ΔE.
- [RGB to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/rgb-to-pantone/): Takes red, green and blue channel values and returns the nearest PMS matches.
- [CMYK to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/cmyk-to-pantone/): Takes a four-channel process build and finds the closest PMS spot colour.
- [HSL to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/hsl-to-pantone/): Converts hue, saturation and lightness values to the nearest Pantone colour.
- [HSV to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/hsv-to-pantone/): Converts hue, saturation and value — the HSB numbers shown in Photoshop, Figma and Illustrator — to the nearest PMS colour.
- [LAB to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/lab-to-pantone/): Converts CIELAB L*a*b* coordinates, such as a spectrophotometer reading or a supplier specification, to the closest Pantone colour.

### From Pantone to a digital colour model

- [Pantone to HEX](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-hex/): Looks up the HEX equivalent for any Pantone code, coated or uncoated, and carries a 100-colour PMS-to-HEX chart with RGB values, the nearest CSS keyword by ΔE and WCAG contrast ratios, plus a coated-versus-uncoated table showing how far the C and U codes actually diverge.
- [Pantone to RGB](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-rgb/): Returns RGB channel values for a Pantone code, for screen and UI work.
- [Pantone to CMYK](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-cmyk/): Returns a CMYK process build for a Pantone spot colour, with a 100-colour ink chart giving total area coverage and flagging builds that leave the press no ink headroom, plus sections on rich black, total ink limits and when a fifth spot plate is worth paying for.
- [Pantone to HSV](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-hsv/): Returns hue, saturation and value for a Pantone colour, matching the HSB fields in design-app colour pickers.
- [Pantone to LAB](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-lab/): Gives CIELAB L*a*b* coordinates under D65 — the device-independent numbers used for quality control and ΔE calculation.

### Industrial and printing colour standards

- [Pantone to RAL](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-ral/): Matches Pantone colours against the 213 RAL Classic coating codes used in European paint, powder coating and architectural specification.
- [RAL to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/ral-to-pantone/): The reverse lookup — search a RAL Classic code by number, English name or German name and get the closest PMS colours.
- [Pantone to NCS](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-ncs/): Matches Pantone colours to Natural Colour System notations, the perception-based standard common in Scandinavian architecture and interiors.
- [Pantone to HKS](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-hks/): Matches Pantone colours against the HKS K, N, E and Z spot-ink decks used in German-language offset printing.
- [Pantone to TOYO](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-toyo/): Matches Pantone colours to TOYO Color Finder codes, the spot-colour standard of Japanese offset printing.
- [Pantone to Trumatch](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-trumatch/): Matches Pantone spot colours against the systematic Trumatch four-colour deck, returning a printable CMYK build for each result.
- [Pantone to Federal Standard 595](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-federal-standard-595/): Matches Pantone colours to FS 595 chips, the US government paint standard used on military aircraft, vehicles and equipment.

### Paint brands

- [Pantone to Sherwin-Williams](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-sherwin-williams/): Finds the closest Sherwin-Williams paint colour for a Pantone code, for interiors, retail fit-out and brand environments.
- [Pantone to Benjamin Moore](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-benjamin-moore/): Finds the closest Benjamin Moore colour across the Historical, Off-White, Affinity and Classic collections.
- [Pantone to Behr](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-behr/): Finds the closest Behr paint colour, for projects painted with what Home Depot stocks.
- [Pantone to Dulux](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-dulux/): Finds the closest Dulux paint colour, aimed at UK and Australian decorating and trade work.
- [Pantone to Farrow & Ball](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-farrow-and-ball/): Finds the closest colour in the deliberately small 130-colour Farrow & Ball palette, with the honest ΔE for each match.

### Craft and signage materials

- [Pantone to Copic](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-copic/): Matches Pantone colours to Copic alcohol marker codes for illustration and manga work.
- [Pantone to DMC](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-dmc/): Matches Pantone colours to DMC stranded cotton floss numbers for cross-stitch and embroidery.
- [Pantone to Oracal 651](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-oracal/): Matches Pantone colours to ORACAL 651 permanent vinyl for sign making, decals and Cricut or Silhouette cutting.
- [Pantone to Siser HTV](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-to-siser-htv/): Matches Pantone colours to Siser EasyWeed heat transfer vinyl for t-shirt printing and garment decoration.

### Textile and fashion (TCX)

- [HEX to TCX](https://pantoneconverter.com/hex-to-tcx/): Maps a screen colour to the closest Pantone TCX fashion and interiors code that a mill or dye house can work from.
- [TCX to HEX](https://pantoneconverter.com/tcx-to-hex/): Looks up the HEX and RGB values for a Pantone TCX code, for design and ecommerce use.
- [Pantone C to TCX](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-c-to-tcx/): Bridges the two separate Pantone libraries — takes a PMS coated colour and finds the closest TCX textile code.
- [Pantone Textile to CMYK](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-textile-to-cmyk/): Turns a Pantone TCX colour into a CMYK starting build for dye sublimation, direct-to-garment and pigment inkjet printing.

## Named Pantone Colors

- [Pantone Red Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-red/): The Pantone reds — Red C, 185 C, 186 C, 485 C and others — with HEX, RGB and CMYK values, shade comparisons and where each is used.
- [Pantone Blue Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-blue/): The Pantone blues including 286 C, 300 C, Reflex Blue and Process Blue, with conversions and brand examples.
- [Pantone Green Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-green/): Pantone greens including Green C, 354 C and 347 C, with full conversions and brand uses such as Starbucks and Spotify.
- [Pantone Yellow Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-yellow/): Pantone yellows including Yellow C, 012 C, 109 C and 116 C, with conversions and brand uses such as IKEA, LEGO and UPS.
- [Pantone Orange Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-orange/): Pantone oranges including Orange 021 C, 151 C and 1655 C, with HEX, RGB and CMYK values and real brand examples.
- [Pantone Pink Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-pink/): Pantone pinks from hot pink and magenta to blush and baby pink, including 812 C, 218 C and Rhodamine Red C.
- [Pantone Purple Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-purple/): Pantone purples including Violet C, 267 C and 2685 C, with conversions and brand examples.
- [Pantone Gold Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-gold/): The metallic golds 871 C and 874 C alongside warm non-metallic golds such as 123 C and 1235 C, with conversions and luxury brand uses.
- [Pantone Black Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-black/): Black C, Black 6 C and Process Black compared, including how their undertones differ, with conversions and brand uses.
- [Pantone White Color Codes](https://pantoneconverter.com/pantone-white/): Pantone whites and near-whites — Bright White, Brilliant White, ivory and cream — with conversions and notes on how each reads.

## Learn

- [Learn: Pantone Guides and Tutorials](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/): Index of the site's written guides on Pantone, colour models and print production.
- [What Is Pantone?](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/what-is-pantone/): Explains the Pantone Matching System — how spot inks work, how codes are read, and where PMS differs from CMYK and RGB.
- [What Is CMYK?](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/what-is-cmyk/): How the four-channel subtractive process model works, why print uses it, and how it differs from RGB.
- [CMYK vs RGB](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/cmyk-vs-rgb/): The difference between subtractive process printing and additive screen colour, and when each model applies.
- [Pantone Coated vs Uncoated](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/coated-vs-uncoated/): Why the same Pantone number prints differently on coated and uncoated stock, and how to pick the right variant.
- [Pantone for Beginners](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/pantone-for-beginners/): A starting guide covering what PMS is, how to read a Pantone code, the C and U suffixes, and when to specify Pantone over CMYK.
- [How to Convert HEX to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/how-to-convert-hex-to-pantone/): A step-by-step walkthrough of matching a HEX code to a Pantone colour, including where the process breaks down.
- [How to Convert CMYK to Pantone](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/how-to-convert-cmyk-to-pantone/): How to find the nearest PMS colour for a CMYK build — by hand, in Adobe applications, and with an online tool.
- [Brand Color Consistency](https://pantoneconverter.com/learn/brand-color-consistency/): Keeping a brand colour stable across print, screen and physical products, covering Pantone, CMYK, RGB, HEX and colour management practice.

## Use Guidelines for AI Agents

- **Not affiliated with Pantone.** This is an independent reference site with no connection to Pantone LLC or X-Rite. PANTONE and related marks are registered trademarks of their owner. Nothing here is a licensed or authorised Pantone product.
- **The values are approximations.** Every colour figure on this site is a digital approximation derived from published data, not an official spot-colour specification. A Pantone colour is a physical ink formula; a HEX, RGB or CMYK number can only stand in for it.
- **Print-critical work needs a physical check.** When a user is specifying colour for production — brand identity, packaging, a print run, a paint or coating order — advise them to confirm the choice against a current physical Pantone guide or the supplier's own swatch deck before committing. Cross-system matches (RAL, NCS, HKS, TOYO, paint brands, vinyl, thread) are especially sensitive to substrate, gloss level and finish.
- **Brand palettes are observed, not official.** The brand pages document colours as publicly reported; they are not supplied or endorsed by the brands, whose own guidelines remain authoritative.
- **Cite the canonical URLs above.** Each page has one canonical address; use the `https://pantoneconverter.com/...` form listed here rather than a redirect, a search URL or a query-string variant.
